use_cases.name: Engage a contractor and register its workers by class
use_cases.goal: Record a signed contractor engagement with the worker classes and rates it supplies, and register each deployed worker with an assignment whose class carries the time and pay policy.

stakeholders.interest: The engagement on file matches the signed contract: vendor, sites, period, classes and rates.
Sees the deployed population by class and rate that later invoices must reconcile against.
Every contract worker at the gate is registered, enrolled and governed by the correct class policy.
Rest days and overtime eligibility follow the class they were engaged in, not a blanket contract setting.

use_cases.trigger: A contract with a labour contractor is signed.
preconditions: The contractor exists as an active vendor for the entity and site.
The worker classes to be supplied (for example WC-3PE and WC-3PH) are configured with rest-day, overtime-eligibility and wage-basis policy.
postconditions_success: An active engagement records vendor, entity, site, contract period, classes, rate per class and invoice basis.
Each deployed worker holds an active assignment with class, site, shift group, vendor and supervisor, and is enrolled on site punch sources.
The engagement screen shows the deployed population by class and rate.
postconditions_failure: A worker who is already active under another engagement, or who would exceed the engagement's headcount by class, is not registered.

main_flow.action: Records the engagement: vendor, entity, site, contract period and the worker classes the vendor will supply.
Enters the agreed rate per worker class, the invoice basis (monthly, per worker per day) and the headcount by class.
Confirms each class carries its own rest-day, overtime and wage-basis policy; the engagement itself holds no such policy.
Submits the list of workers to deploy with identity, UAN, worker class and site.
Registers each worker with an assignment carrying class, site, shift group, default shift, vendor and reporting supervisor.
Checks the worker is not active under another engagement and that deployment stays within the headcount for the class.
Enrols the registered workers on the site's punch sources.
Activates the assignments and shows the deployed population by class and rate on the engagement screen.

alternate_flows.condition: A deployed worker moves to a different class during the engagement, for example from helper to employee.
steps: HR operations records a new effective-dated assignment with the new class.
From the effective date the new class's rest-day and overtime policy applies and earlier days are unaffected.

alternate_flows.condition: The signed contract renews an existing engagement.
steps: HR operations extends the contract period on the existing engagement and active workers carry over without re-registration.

exception_flows.condition: A class named on the engagement has no rest-day or overtime policy configured.
exception_flows.handling: The engagement cannot be activated until the class policy is configured; policy is never entered on the engagement instead.

exception_flows.condition: The worker is already active under another engagement.
exception_flows.handling: Registration is refused and the message names the existing engagement and site.

exception_flows.condition: Registering the worker would exceed the engagement's headcount for that class.
exception_flows.handling: Registration is refused with the class headcount and current deployment shown.

nfrs: Class is the unit of policy: a change to a class's rest-day policy applies to every worker in that class across all engagements from its effective date.
Engagement and assignment changes are effective-dated and auditable.

user_stories.want: to register employees and helpers from one vendor under their own classes
user_stories.so_that: each group gets the rest days its class allows

acceptance.when: I register E1034 Imran Shaikh as WC-3PE and E1036 Lakshmi Rao as WC-3PH
acceptance.then: Sunday 06 Sep resolves as Weekly Off for E1034 and Working for E1036

acceptance.given: the same engagement
acceptance.then: no rest-day or overtime field is offered on the engagement; each class's policy is shown read-only

user_stories.want: to see the deployed population by class and rate for each engagement
user_stories.so_that: I know what a correct invoice should look like before it arrives

acceptance.given: VN-01 has 4 active workers across WC-3PE and WC-3PH at a rate of 700 rupees per worker per day
acceptance.then: I see the count per class, the rate per class and the invoice basis

acceptance.given: one of those assignments ends on 15 Sep
acceptance.when: I view the deployed population for 16 Sep
acceptance.then: the count for that worker's class is reduced by one

user_stories.so_that: no person is billed twice or enrolled under two engagements

use_cases.name: Reconcile a contractor invoice against attendance
use_cases.goal: Reconcile each monthly contractor invoice against the attendance the system already holds, by class and rate, so any variance is visible and decided before payment.

stakeholders.interest: Pays only for worker-days the attendance supports.
Receives a clear, evidenced query rather than an unexplained short payment.
Every invoice decision carries its variance evidence.

use_cases.trigger: A contractor submits its monthly invoice.
preconditions: An active engagement defines classes, rates and invoice basis for the vendor and site.
Attendance days for the deployed workers in the invoice period have been computed.
postconditions_success: The invoice is reconciled with system days, variance days and variance amount by class and rate, and contingent.invoice.reconciled is emitted.
Finance's decision (approve, query or reject) is recorded with the variance evidence attached.
postconditions_failure: An invoice with unsupported days is not paid in full; the unsupported amount is held under query.

main_flow.action: Submits the monthly invoice for the deployed population, stating claimed days and amount by worker class and rate.
Reconciles claimed days against attendance held, by class and rate, showing variance days and amount before payment.
Approves, queries or rejects the invoice in the approvals inbox, with the variance evidence attached to the decision.

alternate_flows.condition: Claimed days equal attendance days for every class.
steps: The invoice is marked as matching with zero variance and presented for approval at the claimed amount.

alternate_flows.condition: Finance passes only the supported amount and queries the remainder.
steps: The supported amount is passed for payment and the variance amount is held under query with the vendor.

alternate_flows.condition: The vendor answers a query with a corrected invoice or further evidence.
steps: The corrected invoice replaces the original claim and is reconciled again.

exception_flows.condition: An invoice line names a class or rate that is not on the engagement.
exception_flows.handling: The line is refused at submission with the engagement's classes and rates shown.

exception_flows.condition: A worker-day is claimed with no attendance behind it.
exception_flows.handling: The day is listed in the variance and raised as an exception that blocks vendor payment, not employee payroll.

exception_flows.condition: A decision is attempted without the variance evidence.
exception_flows.handling: The decision cannot be saved until the reconciliation evidence is attached; by default it is attached automatically.

nfrs: Reconciliation of a 500-worker monthly invoice completes within 30 seconds of submission.
Variance is shown before any payment is released, never after.

user_stories.want: the variance between claimed and attended days shown before I pay
user_stories.so_that: we do not pay for days nobody worked

acceptance.given: invoice INV-VN01-2609 claims 56 worker-days at 700 rupees (39,200 rupees) and attendance holds 53
acceptance.then: a variance of 3 days and 2,100 rupees is shown, listing E1036 on 06, 07 and 13 Sep

acceptance.given: invoice INV-VN01-2608 claims 104 worker-days and attendance holds 104
acceptance.then: variance is zero and 72,800 rupees is presented for approval

user_stories.want: to pass the supported amount and query the rest with evidence attached
user_stories.so_that: the vendor is paid promptly for undisputed days and knows exactly what is queried

acceptance.given: the reconciled INV-VN01-2609
acceptance.when: I pass 37,100 rupees and raise a query on the remaining 2,100 rupees
acceptance.then: the decision records the evidence reference, the passed amount and the held amount, and the invoice status is Query raised

acceptance.given: the same query
acceptance.then: it lists the three unsupported worker-days by worker and date

user_stories.want: claimed days without attendance raised as exceptions that block vendor payment only
user_stories.so_that: I can check the gate records without holding anyone's salary

acceptance.given: 07 Sep is claimed for E1036 on INV-VN01-2609 with no punch recorded
acceptance.then: an exception of type 'Vendor claim without attendance' with severity 'Blocks vendor payment' appears in the exception queue

acceptance.given: the same exception is open
acceptance.when: the employee payroll run is prepared
acceptance.then: it is not blocked by this exception

use_cases.name: Verify a contractor's monthly statutory compliance as principal employer
use_cases.goal: Collect and verify each contractor's monthly PF and ESI filing evidence and hold it per engagement and period, so the principal employer's exposure is known before payment.

stakeholders.interest: Knows every month which contractors have evidenced their PF and ESI payments; the principal employer may be liable for a contractor's unpaid contributions (to be validated by Legal).
Sees the verification status of a vendor before approving its invoice.
Can retrieve the evidence and verification decision for any vendor and period.

use_cases.trigger: The monthly statutory filing cycle opens.
preconditions: The vendor master holds the contractor's PF establishment code and ESI code.
At least one engagement with that vendor had deployed workers in the previous wage period.
postconditions_success: A verification record per engagement and period holds the challans, payment proof and wage register, with outcome, reviewer and date.
The verification status is visible on the engagement and on the vendor's invoices.
postconditions_failure: Engagements without evidence by the due date are marked Held and escalated with a recommended payment hold.

main_flow.action: Opens a verification item for each active engagement for the previous wage period when the monthly cycle starts.
Requests the PF and ESI challans with payment proof and the wage register from each vendor, with a due date.
Uploads the challans, payment proof and wage register against the verification item.
Checks completeness: both challans present, period correct and establishment codes matching the vendor master.
Reviews the evidence and records the outcome as verified, query or not compliant, with comments.
Stores the evidence and outcome against the engagement and period and shows the status on the engagement and its invoices.
Escalates engagements not verified by the due date to the Director / approver with a recommended payment hold.

alternate_flows.condition: The compliance owner raises a query.
steps: The vendor receives the query with the points to correct and uploads revised evidence.

alternate_flows.condition: An engagement ended during the period.
steps: A verification item is still opened for the final period worked.

exception_flows.condition: The vendor has not uploaded evidence by the due date.
exception_flows.handling: The item is marked Held, the vendor's invoices show the Held status and the item is escalated.

exception_flows.condition: A challan's establishment code does not match the vendor master.
exception_flows.handling: The evidence is rejected with the expected and received codes shown and the vendor is asked to re-upload.

nfrs: Evidence is retained per vendor and period for the statutory retention period (to be validated by Legal) and is read-only after verification.
Every verification outcome records reviewer, date and comment.

user_stories.want: vendors without filing evidence by the due date flagged as Held
user_stories.so_that: our exposure as principal employer is visible before we pay them

acceptance.given: VN-01 Sharada Manpower Services has not produced its August 2026 PF challan by the due date
acceptance.then: VN-01's August verification is Held, escalated to the Director / approver and shown on VN-01's invoices

acceptance.given: VN-02 uploads its August PF and ESI challans and wage register with establishment codes matching the vendor master
acceptance.then: I can mark August Verified and the evidence is stored against VN-02's engagement and period

user_stories.want: to retrieve a contractor's verified evidence for any period
user_stories.so_that: I can test the principal-employer control without asking the team

acceptance.given: VN-05 Kaveri Industrial Services' August 2026 verification is Verified
acceptance.then: I see the challans, payment proof, wage register, reviewer and verification date, all read-only

acceptance.given: the same record
acceptance.when: I attempt to replace a document
acceptance.then: the action is not available to me

user_stories.want: the vendor's verification status shown on its invoice
user_stories.so_that: I do not approve a payment without knowing the compliance position

acceptance.given: VN-01's August verification is Held
acceptance.then: the verification status Held is shown with a link to the verification item

acceptance.given: VN-02's August verification is Verified
acceptance.then: the status Verified is shown with the verification date

use_cases.name: Maintain contract-labour vendors with licences, rate cards and caps
use_cases.goal: Maintain each labour contractor with statutory registrations, site licences, rate cards and per-site headcount caps so engagements and invoices rest on verified vendor data.

stakeholders.interest: No contractor deploys at a site beyond its licence or after the licence or contract expires.
Invoices reconcile against an effective-dated rate card.
Knows how many contract workers each vendor may deploy at the site.

use_cases.trigger: A new labour contractor is onboarded, or a vendor's licence, rate or cap changes.
preconditions: The vendor's PAN, PF establishment code, ESI code and contract labour licence for each site are available.
The worker classes the vendor will supply are configured.
postconditions_success: An active vendor holds registrations, site licences with validity and licensed headcount, an effective-dated rate card per class and a headcount cap per site.
Expiry alerts are scheduled for each licence and contract.
postconditions_failure: A vendor with missing registrations, an expired licence or a cap above its licence is not activated.

main_flow.action: Creates the vendor with legal name, PAN, PF establishment code, ESI code and engagement type.
Validates identifier formats and refuses a PAN or PF code already held by another vendor.
Records the contract labour licence for each site with number, validity dates and licensed headcount, attaching a copy.
Records the rate card per worker class with effective dates and the invoice basis.
Sets the headcount cap per site, not exceeding the licensed headcount.
Approves activation of the vendor.
Activates the vendor for engagements and schedules alerts ahead of each licence and contract expiry.

alternate_flows.condition: An existing vendor's rate is revised.
steps: Finance adds a new rate card row effective from the agreed date; the previous rate remains for earlier periods.

alternate_flows.condition: The vendor serves more than one site.
steps: A separate licence, validity and licensed headcount is recorded for each site.

exception_flows.condition: The headcount cap entered exceeds the site's licensed headcount.
exception_flows.handling: The cap is refused with the licensed headcount shown.
New deployments at that site are blocked and existing deployments are flagged to the compliance owner.

exception_flows.condition: A contract end date is within the alert lead time and no renewal has been raised.
exception_flows.handling: An alert is raised to HR operations and the compliance owner naming the vendor, site and end date.

exception_flows.condition: A new rate card row overlaps an existing row for the same class.
exception_flows.handling: The row is refused with the overlapping period shown.

nfrs: Vendor identifiers and licence documents are stored with access limited to HR operations, Compliance owner and Finance.
Rate cards and caps are effective-dated so past invoices always reconcile against the values then in force.

user_stories.want: the per-site headcount cap held within the vendor's licence
user_stories.so_that: we never deploy more contract workers than the licence permits

acceptance.given: VN-01's licence at Peenya Works permits 20 workers
acceptance.when: I set a cap of 25 for VN-01 at Peenya Works
acceptance.then: the cap is refused and the licensed headcount of 20 is shown

acceptance.given: a cap of 4 for VN-01 at Peenya Works with 4 workers deployed
acceptance.then: registration is refused and the cap is named

user_stories.want: an alert before a contractor's contract or licence expires without renewal
user_stories.so_that: workers are not deployed under an expired contract

acceptance.given: VN-04 Deccan Facility Services' contract at Medchal Works ends on 30 Sep 2026 and no renewal has been raised
acceptance.when: the configured 30-day lead time is reached on 31 Aug 2026
acceptance.then: I receive an alert naming VN-04, Medchal Works and the 30 Sep end date

acceptance.given: the contract is not renewed by 30 Sep
acceptance.when: a VN-04 worker is submitted for deployment on 01 Oct
acceptance.then: the deployment is blocked

user_stories.so_that: invoices before and after a rate change reconcile at the right rate

acceptance.given: VN-01's rate is 700 rupees per worker per day from 01 Apr 2025
acceptance.when: I add a rate of 735 rupees effective 01 Oct 2026
acceptance.then: September 2026 invoices reconcile at 700 and October 2026 invoices at 735

acceptance.given: the same rate card
acceptance.when: I add a row effective 15 Sep 2026 that overlaps the existing rows
acceptance.then: the row is refused with the overlapping period shown

use_cases.name: Verify contractor challans against deployed workers before invoice approval
use_cases.goal: Reconcile each vendor's monthly PF and ESI challans and wage register against the contract workers actually deployed, and hold invoice approval until verification is complete.

stakeholders.interest: Every deployed contract worker is covered by the contractor's contributions before the contractor is paid.
Invoice approval is gated by a clear, worker-level verification result.
Contract workers' PF and ESI contributions are actually paid.

use_cases.trigger: A vendor uploads its monthly challans and wage register, or the invoice for that period reaches approval.
preconditions: The vendor master holds PF and ESI establishment codes (CTG-UC-004).
Attendance for the vendor's deployed workers in the period has been computed.
postconditions_success: A worker-level reconciliation shows each deployed worker as covered, missing or mismatched, and the vendor-period is Verified.
Invoice approval for that vendor and period is released.
postconditions_failure: Invoice approval remains blocked while verification is incomplete, unless a Director / approver releases it with the waived rule named.

main_flow.action: Uploads the month's PF and ESI challans, member-wise contribution lists and wage register.
Confirms challan period and establishment codes match the vendor master and records payment dates.
Matches every worker deployed in the period, from attendance, to the contribution lists by UAN and ESI number.
Compares wage-register days with attendance days held for each worker.
Produces a worker-level reconciliation: covered, missing from contributions, or days mismatched.
Reviews the reconciliation and accepts it or raises a query to the vendor.
Marks the vendor-period Verified and releases the hold on invoice approval for that period.
Approves the vendor's invoice for the period with the verification and variance evidence attached.

alternate_flows.condition: The compliance owner raises a query.
steps: The vendor receives the worker-level discrepancies and uploads corrected evidence.

exception_flows.condition: Challans for the period have not been uploaded.
exception_flows.handling: Invoice approval for that vendor and period is blocked with the reason 'statutory verification incomplete'.

exception_flows.condition: A deployed worker is missing from a contribution list.
exception_flows.handling: The worker is listed as missing and the vendor-period cannot be marked Verified until resolved.

exception_flows.condition: Payment must be released before verification completes.
exception_flows.handling: Only a Director / approver may release it; the release names the waived rule and records approver identity and reason.

nfrs: Worker-level matching for a 500-worker vendor completes within 60 seconds of upload.
Identifiers in uploaded documents are visible only to roles with a compliance need.

user_stories.want: invoice approval blocked until the vendor's challans are verified
user_stories.so_that: we never pay a contractor whose statutory dues are unevidenced

acceptance.given: VN-01 has not produced its August 2026 PF challan
acceptance.then: approval is blocked with the reason 'statutory verification incomplete for Aug 2026'

acceptance.given: VN-01's August challans are uploaded and the vendor-period is marked Verified
acceptance.then: approval is available

user_stories.want: each deployed worker matched to the contribution lists
user_stories.so_that: I can see exactly who is not covered

acceptance.given: VN-01 deployed 4 workers in August including E1034 and E1036
acceptance.when: the ESI contribution list omits E1036
acceptance.then: the reconciliation shows E1036 as missing and Verified cannot be selected

acceptance.given: the wage register shows 26 days for E1034 and attendance holds 26
acceptance.then: E1034 is shown as covered with no day mismatch

user_stories.want: to release a held payment with the waived rule named
user_stories.so_that: an exceptional release is deliberate and traceable

acceptance.given: VN-01's August verification is incomplete and its invoice is blocked
acceptance.when: I release the invoice with the reason 'Challan paid, upload delayed; evidence due 10 Oct'
acceptance.then: the release records me, the time, the reason and the waived rule

acceptance.given: the release is recorded
acceptance.then: the waiver and its reason are shown alongside the decision

use_cases.name: Complete safety induction and PPE issue before gate access
use_cases.goal: Ensure every contract worker completes the site safety induction and receives the required PPE before their gate access is activated.

stakeholders.interest: No contract worker enters the shop floor without induction and PPE, supporting obligations under the Factories Act 1948 (to be validated by Legal).
Knows the site hazards and has the protective equipment before starting work.
Knows what each worker must complete before they can be deployed.

use_cases.trigger: A contract worker is registered for deployment at a site (CTG-UC-001).
preconditions: The site has a safety induction programme and a PPE requirement list per worker class or role.
The worker has an assignment at the site with gate access not yet active.
postconditions_success: Induction completion and each PPE item issued are recorded and acknowledged, and gate access is active for the site.
postconditions_failure: Gate access stays pending and any gate punch attempt is refused and logged.

main_flow.action: On registration, sets the worker's gate access to Pending induction and creates induction and PPE checklist items for the site and role.
Schedules the worker into the next site safety induction session.
Attends the induction and completes the assessment.
Records induction completion with date, trainer and assessment result.
Issues the PPE set required for the role, such as safety shoes, helmet and goggles, recording each item and issue date.
Acknowledges receipt of each PPE item.
Confirms the induction and PPE checklist are complete, activates gate access and enrols the worker on the site's gate terminals.
Accepts the worker's first gate punch, which enters the standard punch path.

alternate_flows.condition: The worker completed this site's induction within its validity period under an earlier engagement.
steps: The earlier induction record is reused and only the PPE checklist is completed.

exception_flows.condition: The worker fails the induction assessment.
exception_flows.handling: Gate access stays pending and the worker is scheduled into another session.

exception_flows.condition: The worker attempts a gate punch before access is active.
exception_flows.handling: Entry is refused, the attempt is recorded and an exception is raised to the time office.

exception_flows.condition: A required PPE item has not been issued because it is out of stock.
exception_flows.handling: Gate access stays pending and the shortfall is reported to the time office.

exception_flows.condition: The worker's induction passes its validity period.
exception_flows.handling: Gate access is suspended until a refresher induction is recorded.

nfrs: Gate access activation reaches the site gate terminals within 5 minutes of the checklist completing.
Induction and PPE records are retained for the duration required by the applicable safety rules (to be validated by Legal).

user_stories.want: gate access activated only after induction and PPE are complete
user_stories.so_that: no contract worker reaches the shop floor unprepared

acceptance.given: E1036 is registered at Peenya Works and has not completed the safety induction
acceptance.when: she presents at the gate terminal
acceptance.then: entry is refused, the attempt is logged and an exception is raised to the time office

acceptance.given: her induction is recorded as passed and safety shoes, helmet and goggles are issued and acknowledged
acceptance.then: gate access is activated and her next gate punch is accepted

user_stories.want: to acknowledge each PPE item I receive
user_stories.so_that: there is a clear record of what I was issued

acceptance.given: a helmet, safety shoes and goggles are issued to me on 02 Sep
acceptance.when: I acknowledge receipt at the site kiosk
acceptance.then: each item is recorded against me with the issue date and my acknowledgement

acceptance.given: only two of the three required items are issued
acceptance.then: my gate access stays pending and the missing item is shown

user_stories.want: a site list of contract workers with induction and PPE status
user_stories.so_that: I can evidence the control during an inspection

acceptance.given: VN-01 has 4 active workers at Peenya Works
acceptance.when: I open the site induction and PPE status list
acceptance.then: each worker shows induction date, validity end, PPE items issued and gate access status

acceptance.given: one worker's induction validity has ended
acceptance.then: that worker is flagged and their gate access shows Suspended
